lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good morning and welcome to Radio Tenerify — I'm Alex, here with Mia, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is! Twenty-one degrees and clear blue skies down in the south — weather code zero, people, that means not a cloud in sight. Classic Tenerife summer perfection.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Can't argue with that. Now, we do want to briefly acknowledge a story that made the rounds a while back — a fatal collision involving a tourist bus in Lanzarote in June. A sobering reminder to everyone to stay safe on the roads when you're out exploring the islands.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Take care out there. But on a much brighter note — if you're in or near Santa Cruz this weekend, you are in for a treat!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Yes! Saturday brings the Urban Beach Festival to the Puerto de Santa Cruz, with Beéle headlining his Borondo Tour. Then on Sunday, reggaeton and urban star Kapo makes his very first Tenerife appearance over at the Palmetum car park.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Two big nights, one great weekend. Check the webtenerife website for tickets and details.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Enjoy the sunshine, enjoy the music — and have a wonderful Wednesday, wherever you are on this beautiful island.
